stories.title: Vikes' Smith agrees to deal, back for 15th season
stories.summary: Vikings safety Harrison Smith is returning for a 15th season, with sources telling NFL Network he reached a one-year deal worth $12.25 million.

stories.title: No. 2 Oregon overcomes slow start, survives Boise
stories.summary: Dante Moore threw for 388 yards and three touchdowns, and No. 2 Oregon overcame a slow start to down resilient Boise State 34-27 in the season opener for both teams Saturday.

stories.title: WVU retires record-setting QB White's No. 5 jersey
stories.summary: Pat White's record-setting career at West Virginia two decades ago came full circle when the school retired his No. 5 jersey.

stories.title: Florida revives 'gator bait' cheer 6 years after ban
stories.summary: Florida's "gator bait" cheer, banned in 2020 over concerns about possible racial undertones, returned to the Swamp early in the first quarter of Saturday's season opener against Florida Atlantic.

stories.title: Dodgers hold Ohtani out of lineup 3rd straight day
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani, who expressed soreness in his neck and along his right arm in Wednesday's 8-6 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals, is out of the Los Angeles Dodgers' lineup for a third straight game Saturday, but he has not yet been placed on the injured list.
